title: RESAMPLE A SURFACE TO A DIFFERENT MESH
description:
Resamples a surface file, given two spherical surfaces that are in register.  If ADAP_BARY_AREA is used, exactly one of -area-surfs or -area-metrics must be specified.  This method is not generally recommended for surface resampling, but is provided for completeness.

The BARYCENTRIC method is generally recommended for anatomical surfaces, in order to minimize smoothing.

For cut surfaces (including flatmaps), use -surface-cut-resample.

Instead of resampling a spherical surface, the -surface-sphere-project-unproject command is recommended.

The <method> argument must be one of the following:

ADAP_BARY_AREA
BARYCENTRIC

current_sphere.description: a sphere surface with the mesh that the input surface is currently on

new_sphere.description: a sphere surface that is in register with <current-sphere> and has the desired output mesh

area_surfs.description: specify surfaces to do vertex area correction based on

current_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for <current-sphere> mesh

new_area.description: a metric file with vertex areas for <new-sphere> mesh

area_metrics.description: specify vertex area metrics to do area correction based on

bypass_sphere_check.description: ADVANCED: allow the current and new 'spheres' to have arbitrary shape as long as they follow the same contour
